# sovIT.xyz - Sovereign IT Services

> sovIT.xyz is a Bitcoin-native IT consulting firm specializing in data ownership, security, and technological sovereignty. Founded by Cameron, it offers open-source solutions, self-hosted infrastructure, and enterprise-grade systems for individuals and organizations seeking technological independence.

## Services

### Support & Consulting
- Technical Support: Responsive support for all sovereign technology needs (Remote, On-site, Consulting)
- Hardware Imaging: Secure device imaging with open-source software for laptops and phones (PXE Boot, Linux, GrapheneOS)
- Sovereign Hardware Recommendations: Curated hardware guidance for networking, computing, phones, and security
- Advertisement Consulting: Privacy-respecting advertising strategies and sovereign marketing solutions

### Infrastructure & Administration
- System Administration: Reliable management and maintenance of server infrastructure (Linux, Ansible, Automation)
- Cloud Administration: Sovereign cloud deployment, monitoring, and management (Kubernetes, Docker, Self-hosted)
- Open Source System Integration: Seamless integration of open-source tools into workflows (Linux, FOSS, APIs)
- ERP, ITSM & Collaboration: Business management, asset tracking, and team collaboration platforms (ERPNext, GLPI, Nextcloud)

### Security & Bitcoin
- OpSec & Bitcoin Operations: Operational security hardening and secure Bitcoin infrastructure (Node Ops, Cold Storage, OpSec)
- Web Security Testing: Penetration testing and vulnerability assessments for web applications and APIs (OWASP, Burp Suite, Reporting)
- Lightning Channel Recovery: Expert recovery services for Lightning Network channels and funds (Lightning Network, LND, CLN)

### Development & Innovation
- Open Source Website Creation: Modern, performant websites built on open-source stacks (React, Hugo, Static Sites)
- Software Development: Custom application development with open-source frameworks (Python, JavaScript, Go)
- Home Cloud & Sovereign AI: Self-hosted cloud and local AI deployment for full data sovereignty (Ollama, Nextcloud, Home Lab)
- Technology R&D: Research and development of emerging open-source technologies

## Service Bundles
- Sovereign Starter (Essentials): Technical Support, Hardware Imaging, Sovereign Hardware Recs, Open Source Integration
- Digital Fortress (Recommended): Everything in Starter + Home Cloud & Sovereign AI, OpSec & Bitcoin Operations, Web Security Testing
- Full Sovereignty (Complete): Everything in Fortress + Cloud Administration, Website Creation, Software Development, ERP/ITSM & Collaboration

## Core Values
- Data Ownership: Your data belongs to you. Systems that ensure complete control and sovereignty over digital assets.
- Security: Enterprise-grade security built on proven cryptographic principles and zero-trust architecture.
- Open-Source Principles: Transparency, auditability, and freedom from vendor lock-in through open-source technologies.
- Sovereignty: True technological independence. Systems that serve you, not external interests.

## Licensing
All work is open-sourced under AGPL-3.0 by default. Custom license releases available for an additional fee.

## About
Cameron is the founder of sovIT.xyz. He has been passionate about computing since childhood — building PCs, exploring cybersecurity, coding, and repairing systems. He has professional enterprise IT experience and now focuses on sovereign, open-source technology solutions.
